verdict.rationale: The evidence shows programmatic single-flow capabilities such as payouts, account creation and card issuing. Card issuing is described as working "at scale", but no item documents a bulk or batch operation (e.g. batch payouts, bulk card creation, or bulk bill actions) that acts on many items at once. "At scale" describes capacity, not a multi-item bulk action, so it earns no credit. The axis applies to a payments and spend platform, so the absence of evidence yields none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
